full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media collage brings several women's faces into view through a dense field of distressed paper and ink. The largest face occupies the center-left, its pale gray eyes looking directly outward from beneath strong dark brows. A broad nose and closed dark mouth remain visible, but cheeks and forehead fade into layers of printed scraps. At the upper right, another pair of eyes emerges from warmer ochre papers; at the far right edge, part of a third face shows one clear eye and a curved cheek. These overlapping identities do not sit in separate panels. Their contours are interrupted by torn rectangles, handwritten-looking marks, small diagrams, and faded type fragments that cross both faces and background. Cream, parchment yellow, warm beige, smoky gray, sepia, and black dominate, with only minute rusty-red accents in small stamps or symbols. Some areas resemble translucent photographic transfers, others rough brush or graphite shading, and still others actual scraps pasted over the image. The collage is deliberately abraded: scuffs, scratches, ink splatters, and uneven paper edges remain visible. The viewer can read the direct gaze of the large left eye despite the surface noise because the dark iris and eyelashes are crisply defined. A smaller right eye supplies a second focal point at a different scale, while the dark mouth anchors the lower center. There is little spatial depth; all information seems pressed into an aged, layered plane. Light is flat and diffuse, with value established by ink density and pale paper rather than cast shadow. The composition feels mysterious and archival, suggesting memory and identity through partial visibility without allowing the faces to fully separate from the materials around them.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介拼贴让几张女子面孔从密集磨旧纸张和墨痕中浮现。最大的脸占据中左部，浅灰眼睛在深眉下直接望向外面。宽鼻与闭合的深色嘴仍可辨，脸颊和额头却退入层叠印刷纸片。右上另一双眼从更暖的赭色纸片中显出；最右缘第三张脸只露一只清楚眼睛与弯曲脸颊。这些重叠身份并不坐在分隔开的画框里。撕裂矩形、似手写的记号、小图示与褪色印字碎片切断她们的轮廓，横穿面孔与背景。奶油、羊皮纸黄、暖米、烟灰、棕褐和黑占主导，只有微小锈红点缀出现在印戳或符号里。有些区域像半透明摄影转印，有些像粗刷或石墨阴影，还有些像真正贴上的纸碎。拼贴有意磨蚀：擦伤、刮痕、墨溅和不整纸边仍可见。尽管表面嘈杂，最大的左眼目光仍可读，因为深色虹膜与睫毛清晰。较小右眼以不同尺度提供第二焦点，深嘴则锚定中下部。空间纵深很少；所有信息像压进一张旧而层叠的平面。光平坦漫射，明暗由墨量与浅纸建立，而非投影。构图神秘而有档案感，通过局部可见性暗示记忆与身份，却不让面孔从周围材料中完全分离。
style_prompt_en: A distressed mixed-media collage compresses translucent transfers, torn papers, graphite shading, faded typography-like fragments, and scattered ink marks into one shallow plane. Cream and parchment yellow provide broad ground areas; smoky gray, sepia, and near-black build fragmented focal shapes; tiny rust-red stamps add restrained color. A few sharply defined dark elliptical details hold attention while surrounding contours are repeatedly broken by overlaid rectangles and scratches. Paper edges vary between torn, straight, and partly dissolved, giving the surface layered age. Some marks sit crisp and opaque on top, while others ghost through paler washes beneath. Illumination is diffuse and nearly flat; contrast comes from ink coverage and selective clarity rather than directional shadows. The composition is densely textured but not uniform, with several clear islands embedded in a larger weathered field. It feels archival, elusive, and tactile, as if different moments have been pressed onto the same worn sheet.
style_prompt_zh: 磨旧混合媒介拼贴把半透明转印、撕纸、石墨阴影、褪色排字般碎片与散落墨痕压进一个浅平面。奶油与羊皮纸黄提供宽阔底域；烟灰、棕褐和近黑构成碎裂焦点形；微小锈红印戳添克制彩色。少数清楚的深色椭圆细节保持注意力，周围轮廓却反复被叠加矩形与刮痕切断。纸边在撕裂、笔直和部分溶解之间变化，给表面层叠旧感。有些记号清晰不透明地坐在最上层，另一些像幽灵般透过下方浅色水洗。照明漫射且近乎平坦；对比来自墨量与选择性清晰，而非定向阴影。构图纹理密集却不均匀，几个清楚岛屿嵌在更大的风化色域里。它有档案般、难以捉摸且有触感的气质，仿佛不同时刻被压在同一张磨旧纸上。
theme_en: Fragmented women's faces emerging through distressed vintage papers and ink marks
theme_zh: 三张女子面孔从磨旧纸片与墨迹中碎片化浮现
name: Wendy Vecchi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
